documents.title: POST /events
documents.content: Accepts a JSON payload describing an event and returns a 202 with the assigned event_id. Idempotency keys are honored on this endpoint for up to 24 hours. Payloads larger than 1 MB are rejected with 413.

documents.title: GET /events/{id}
documents.content: Returns the canonical representation of an ingested event including enrichments. Results are available within two seconds of ingestion under normal conditions. Returns 404 if the event_id is unknown or has expired from the hot store.

documents.title: DELETE /events/{id}
documents.content: Marks the event for purge across both hot and cold storage tiers. Deletion is asynchronous and can take up to 24 hours to propagate. The endpoint returns 202 immediately on a valid request.
